types.name: DrawablePolygon
types.summary: A Drawable class for drawing a filled or unfilled polygon from a list of points

members.name: Points
members.summary:
Gets or sets the polygon points, each with a position relative to the top-left of the drawable's bounds and a color. The editor keeps positions non-negative by moving the position, unless the origin is not top-left.
The alpha of a point color is how much of it is blended into DrawablePolygon.Color, so transparent uses the polygon color unchanged.

members.name: Blend
members.summary: Gets or sets how point colors are blended into DrawablePolygon.Color, unless a point has its own blend.

members.name: Texture
members.summary: Gets or sets the texture drawn inside the filled polygon, tinted with DrawablePolygon.Color and the point colors.

members.name: TextureMode
members.summary: Gets or sets how the texture is mapped onto the polygon: stretched over the bounding box, or drawn at its natural size and clipped to the polygon.

members.name: Color
members.summary: Gets or sets the color associated with the object.

members.name: Filled
members.summary: Gets or sets if the polygon should be filled or only drawn with a line around the border

members.name: Size
members.summary:
Gets the size of the polygon, which is the bounding extent of its points (including negative ones).
Setting it scales the points from the top-left of the bounds so the shape is kept but fits the new size.

members.name: BoundsMin
members.summary: Gets the top-left corner of the bounds in point space, the smallest X and Y of the points.

members.name: GetPointColor
members.summary: Gets the color a point is drawn with, the point color blended into the component color by the point color's alpha.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The point index.

members.name: TryNormalize
members.signature: public bool TryNormalize(IReadOnlyList<Vec2> points, out List<Vec2> normalized, out Vec2 position)
members.summary:
Shifts the points so the smallest X and Y are 0 and compensates with a new Drawable2d.Position so the polygon does not move visually, keeping the bounds tight.
Only applies when the origin is top-left (0,0); with another origin the points are kept as they are.
members.returns: True if the points had to be shifted.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: The points to normalize.

parameters.name: normalized
parameters.description: The shifted points when normalization was needed.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to use together with the shifted points.

types.name: Anchor2d
types.summary: Represents a 2D anchor point that defines a position and orientation relative to a parent entity.
types.remarks:
The Entities.Anchor2d class provides a way to specify a position and orientation
in 2D space, either in absolute coordinates or as a fraction of the parent entity's size. The anchor's
position and orientation are used to calculate its screen bounds relative to the parent entity.

members.summary: Gets or sets the orientation type of the object.

members.name: ScreenBounds
members.summary: Gets or sets the screen-space bounds of the current object.
members.remarks:
The bounds are determined relative to the parent object's screen bounds and
the object's orientation. Setting this property adjusts the object's position relative to its
parent.

types.name: Drawable2d
types.summary: Represents a two-dimensional drawable object with position, size, scale, rotation, and origin properties.
types.remarks:
This is a base class for drawable objects in a 2D space. Derived classes can override the Size property
to define custom dimensions. The class provides a concrete BoundingBox implementation that accounts for position,
origin, scale, and rotation.

members.name: Drawable2d
members.summary: Initializes a new instance of the Drawables.Drawable2d class.
members.remarks:
This constructor sets the initial position of the drawable object to Vec2.Zero,
origin to Vec2.Zero (top-left), scale to Vec2.One, and rotation to 0 degrees.

types.name: PolygonColorBlend
types.summary: Specifies how a polygon point color is blended with the polygon color.

members.name: Default
members.summary: For a point, uses the blend of the polygon. For the polygon, behaves like PolygonColorBlend.Normal.

members.name: Normal
members.summary: The point color replaces the polygon color by the alpha of the point color.

members.name: Multiply
members.summary: The colors are multiplied, which darkens.

members.name: Add
members.summary: The colors are added, which brightens.

members.name: Subtract
members.summary: The point color is subtracted from the polygon color.

members.name: Screen
members.summary: The inverted colors are multiplied, which lightens.

members.name: Overlay
members.summary: Multiplies dark parts and screens light parts of the polygon color.

members.name: Darken
members.summary: The darkest of each color channel is used.

members.name: Lighten
members.summary: The lightest of each color channel is used.

members.name: Difference
members.summary: The absolute difference of each color channel is used.

types.name: PolygonTextureMode
types.summary: Specifies how a texture is mapped onto a polygon.

members.name: Stretch
members.summary: The texture's border is wrapped around the points, spread evenly along the polygon outline, so the texture is stretched between the points.

members.name: Bounds
members.summary: The texture is stretched over the bounding box of the points and only the part inside the polygon is drawn.

members.name: Clip
members.summary: The texture is drawn at its natural size from the top-left of the bounding box and clipped to the polygon, leaving what the texture does not cover undrawn.
